messages.subject: Fixing non-UTF8 file
parts:
How can I GREP for those multibyte characters in files that weren't saved in utf-8 encoding? Someone supplied me with such a corpus, and I need a list of their locations so I can manually edit or delete them. (Unless there's a better way to deal with this situation. In this case the corpus isn't overwhelmingly huge, and not all files are affected.)

I've tried listing acceptable characters like [0-9a-zA-Z] plus punctuation and GREPing with NOT(!) but this doesn't work.

Files are all .txt at least, if that matters.
